title: Layout
description: Horizontal: a 520 px strip with rank, pp, accuracy and plays in one row. Vertical: a 264 px card for a screen edge.

title: Show avatar
description: Loads your profile picture from a.ppy.sh, the only request this overlay makes outside vosu; your initial stands in when it cannot load. Off hides the avatar and makes no outside request.

title: Show session changes
description: Under each stat: the change in global rank, pp and play count since this source loaded, kept per account and ruleset. Reload the source to start a new session.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag in the card header.
